title: 第391章 神农一指与火种交付第390章 神魔突袭与三方混战
lines: 虚天负手站在谷口，白发被谷中的热风吹得微微飘拂。金仙巅峰的气息像一潭深不见底的老水，从头到尾不泛一丝波澜。
他没有加入玄晖与独孤求败的剑神对拼，也没有插手魔将与江寒顾长风的缠斗。
他只是站在那里，看着。
看人族剑修如何在涅槃火残片中找护甲接缝的位置；
看那个上仙境的人族如何在绝对黑暗中用太极化生把归无法则剥离成纯阴纯阳两层然后补一张佛光网；
看天仙境持灵刀的人族老兵挺直了腰杆用残破的刀面硬挡魔血转化成的神魂针。
独孤求败在空中余光扫过虚天。
他知道这个老神族现在不出手是因为对方在算计——虚天是太虚天域三大长老之一，距七十二道仅一步之遥，他不出手只有两种可能：
要么觉得玄晖能够独力解决剑修所以不需要多耗神；要么是在等场上的微小变数积累，等到某个极关键的节点时一击贯穿全局——
比如趁着江寒四道神通同时全力运转的空隙直接瞬移到江寒身后将他拿下，一个金仙巅峰的长老突袭一个上仙境的人族，瞬杀。
运气好——重伤。
他正要腾出一段剑意去防备虚天的方向。
忽然一股更加古老、更加磅礴的气息从百兽禁地方向升了起来。
那气息不像攻击，没有外放的愤怒与倾泻——只是沉稳、缓慢、理所当然地升起，像一片一直静静卧在海底的原始大陆忽然抬升了几寸，整片海面便同时荡起了极深极长的长涌。
神农的木杖从天而降。
一根木杖，以木杖本身的物理形态——麻衣老人常年杵在地上磨得油光发亮的陈旧杖杆——从百兽禁地方向划过天际，穿过凤族祖地上空薄到即将消散的混沌封印层，稳稳地插在山谷正中央三方混战的交汇地带。
木杖落地的瞬间没有发出任何声音。
但以杖尖触地点为圆心，方圆数里的地面——凤族祖地赤红色的晶石山谷——同时被染成了极深极厚的翠绿色。
不是植物生长，是神农木杖中封存的万物有灵诀核心法则被释放到了极限：
整片山谷的地脉、岩石、晶石柱都暂时被万物有灵诀的“同化”法则覆盖，将神族的神力与魔族的魔力同一时间压到了极低水位。
神力的净世法则在被持续中和——翠绿领域中神力不再灼烧、不再穿透、不再能够主动攻击。
魔力的归无法则也在同领域中被削弱到近乎不足维持魔族领域形态的程度——深渊之口自动破灭，魔将周围那片被撕开的黑色空间被绿光重新填回正常的空间色调。
玄晖脸色骤变。不是怒，是失声。
“……这是那位的压制？”
他不认得神农。
神族近万年没有跟神农有过直接接触——在他们眼里神农是一个消散在荒古遗域中已经不再存在于文明区的人族逃逸老学者。
但虚天认得这股气息的层级。
他活得太久了，与当年洪荒大战的神族祖辈意识有过短暂的精神对接——在对接中保存的古老感知档案里有一份针对“万物有灵诀”的识别标签：
绿色、同化、非攻击的、大范围生命力覆盖型压制。
这是当年女娲造化法则的副本——被神农在人道层面反复改良后的最终版本。
它不杀任何生灵，但它让领域内的一切暴力法则陷入“万物不互斥”的共存状态。
在这个领域里神族的神力不再是“净世”，魔族的魔力也不再是“归无”。
一切专属属性暂时失效，只留下最基础的物理碰撞。
虚天认出了。
他对玄晖使了个眼色。
金仙巅峰的老牌神族比年轻皇子更懂得及时止损——在这种领域中金仙巅峰仍然保有强大的物理与法则作战能力，但压倒性突破一个同境剑修并立刻拿下他的三名同伴，那已经变得效率显著降低。
而他们不能在这里长时间逗留——荒古遗域深处的其他神兽可能正在往这边慢靠。
深渊魔将更直接，冷哼一声后以巨斧撕开一道空间裂缝带着残余魔兵退走。
魔族从不死磕没有把握的仗。在这片绿色的同化领域里他们很清楚自己的战力被稀释了几成。
玄晖深深看了一眼山谷深处那根插在地上的木杖——以及木杖后方远处百兽禁地那片隐隐发着绿光的盆地。
然后带着神族队伍撤出了谷口。“走。”
木杖从地上自行拔起化为一缕细微绿光飞回百兽禁地方向。
content_en:
Xu Tian stood at the mouth of the valley with his hands behind his hands, his white hair blowing slightly in the hot wind in the valley. The aura of the Golden Immortal Peak is like a bottomless old water, without any ripples from beginning to end.
He did not join in the sword god fight between Xuan Hui and Dugu Qiufei, nor did he intervene in the fight between the Demon General and Jiang Han and Gu Changfeng.
He just stood there, watching.
See how the human swordsman finds the location of the armor seams among the Nirvana Fire fragments;
Look at how the human race who went to the fairyland used Tai Chi Transformation in absolute darkness to peel off the law of return into two layers of pure yin and pure yang and then patch up a net of Buddha's light;
The human veteran holding the spiritual sword in Kantian Fairyland straightened his back and used the broken blade to block the soul needle transformed from the demonic blood.
Dugu Qiubei's peripheral vision swept across the sky.
He knew that the old protoss was not taking action now because the other party was plotting—Xutian was one of the three elders of the Taixu Heavenly Domain and was only one step away from the Seventy-Two Paths. There were only two possibilities for him not to take action:
Either he thinks that Xuan Hui can solve the sword cultivator alone, so he doesn't need to spend more energy; or he is waiting for the accumulation of small variables on the field, and waits for a very critical node to penetrate the whole situation with one blow——
For example, taking advantage of the gap when Jiang Han's four magical powers were operating at full strength at the same time, he teleported directly behind Jiang Han and captured him. An elder at the peak of the Golden Immortal suddenly attacked a human race in the Immortal Realm and killed him instantly.
Good luck - serious injury.
He was about to free up some sword intent to guard against Xu Tian's direction.
Suddenly, an older and more majestic aura rose from the direction of the Beast Forbidden Area.
The breath didn't feel like an attack, there was no outward anger or outpouring - it just rose steadily, slowly, and naturally, like a primitive continent that had been lying quietly on the seabed suddenly rising a few inches, and the entire sea surface simultaneously surged with an extremely deep and long surge.
Shennong's wooden staff fell from the sky.
A wooden stick, in its physical form - an old stick that the old man in sackcloth had polished on the ground for many years - crossed the sky from the direction of the Forbidden City of All Beasts, passed through the thin and dissipating chaotic seal layer over the ancestral land of the Phoenix Clan, and was firmly inserted in the intersection of the three-party melee in the center of the valley.
The wooden staff made no sound the moment it hit the ground.
But with the point where the tip of the stick touched the center of the circle, the ground for several miles around - the crimson crystal valley of the Phoenix Clan's ancestral land - was dyed an extremely deep and thick emerald green at the same time.
It's not the growth of plants, it's the core principle of animism sealed in Shennong's wooden staff being released to the limit:
The entire valley's veins, rocks, and spar pillars were temporarily covered by the "assimilation" law of the animist formula, which suppressed the divine power of the gods and the magic power of the demons to an extremely low level at the same time.
The law of divine power's purification is being continuously neutralized - in the emerald green field, divine power no longer burns, penetrates, and can no longer actively attack.
The return law of magic power has also been weakened in the same field to the extent that it is almost insufficient to maintain the shape of the demon domain - the mouth of the abyss is automatically broken, and the torn black space around the demon general is filled back to the normal space tone with green light.
Xuan Hui's expression suddenly changed. Not angry, just voiceless.
"...Is this someone's suppression?"
He didn't recognize Shen Nong.
The Gods have not had direct contact with Shennong for nearly ten thousand years - in their eyes, Shennong is an escaped old scholar from the human race who disappeared in the ancient ruins and no longer exists in the civilized area.
But Xu Tian recognized the level of this breath.
He has lived for too long, and had a brief spiritual connection with the consciousness of the ancestors of the gods who fought in the prehistoric war. In the ancient perception file saved during the connection, there is an identification label for the "Animist Secret of All Things":
Green, assimilation, non-attack, large-scale vitality coverage type suppression.
This is a copy of Nuwa's creation law - the final version that was repeatedly improved by Shennong on the human level.
It does not kill any living beings, but it puts all the laws of violence in the domain into a state of coexistence where "all things are not mutually exclusive".
In this realm, the divine power of the gods is no longer "purifying the world", and the magic power of the demons is no longer "returning to nothingness".
All exclusive attributes are temporarily invalidated, leaving only the most basic physical collision.
Xu Tian recognized it.
He winked at Xuan Hui.
The veteran gods at the Golden Immortal Peak know how to stop losses in time better than the young princes - in this field, the Golden Immortal Peak still retains strong physical and legal combat capabilities, but overwhelmingly breaking through a sword cultivator of the same realm and immediately taking down three of his companions has become significantly less efficient.
And they can't stay here for a long time - other divine beasts deep in the ancient ruins may be slowly approaching here.
The Abyss Demon General was more direct. He snorted coldly and used his giant ax to tear open a crack in space and retreat with the remaining demon soldiers.
The demons never fight an uncertain battle. In this green assimilation field, they know very well that their combat power has been diluted by several percent.
Xuanhui took a deep look at the wooden stick stuck in the ground deep in the valley - and the faintly green basin of the forbidden land far behind the wooden stick.
Then he led the protoss team out of the valley mouth. "Let's go."
The wooden stick pulled itself up from the ground and turned into a tiny ray of green light that flew back to the direction of the Beast Forbidden Area.
